name: notion-spawn-session
description:
Start a session with a published Custom Agent. Use get_session_status or wait_session to check its progress.

If availability is not already known for this connection, call get_tool_access with {} before using this tool. Reuse the returned access map across tools; check the status and restricted_parameters.

agent_url.description: Published Custom Agent URL in agent://<spaceId>/<agentId> format, as returned by search_agents.

initial_message.description: Initial message for the new session.
